campaign.title: Rename NORMALIZED_AGE to CAPPED_AGE, preserving identity, bindings and behavior.

initial.code:
FUNCTION NORMALIZED_AGE(X)
  NORMALIZED_AGE = X
  IF (X < 0) THEN
    NORMALIZED_AGE = 0
  END IF
  IF (X > 100) THEN
    NORMALIZED_AGE = 100
  END IF
  NORMALIZED_AGE = NORMALIZED_AGE
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION IS_SENIOR(X)
  IS_SENIOR = 0
  IF (NORMALIZED_AGE(X) >= 65) THEN
    IS_SENIOR = 1
  END IF
  IS_SENIOR = IS_SENIOR
END FUNCTION
FUNCTION SENIOR_FLAG(X)
  SENIOR_FLAG = 0
  IF (IS_SENIOR(X) >= 1) THEN
    SENIOR_FLAG = 1
  END IF
  SENIOR_FLAG = SENIOR_FLAG
END FUNCTION
